points.description: Defines classification as mapping data to discrete labels/classes and regression as mapping data to continuous values/real numbers (a continuous function). Both must be stated, making the distinction clear.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two is correctly defined, or the definitions are given but the discrete vs continuous contrast is unclear.

points.description: States how error differs: classification error is the number (count) of misclassifications; regression error is the summed distance/difference between true and predicted values. Equivalent wording accepted (e.g. misclassification rate vs. sum of squared or absolute errors).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two error measures is correctly given.
